description:
*In a season when cherry blossom petals scatter on the dry wind, I fell in love with a pale faced poet. My first experience of unrequited love was like a fever.
Each time I suffered from it, I caught my heated breath and quietly sank into misery. Yet that spring was undeniably the most lyrical season of my life.*

Baek Seonghyeon, a poor working student, returns to university with a completely ruined timetable after getting the course registration date wrong. Forced to attend even a literature class he has no interest in, he looks up the course withdrawal period and happens to notice a note taking job posting on campus. Twice a week, a monthly pay of 1.5 million won. Without a second thought, Baek Seonghyeon sends in his application.

Never once imagining that there, he would meet a poet who would completely upend his life.
